veranderings.blok: Kultuur sê nie hoe jy moet leef nie
veranderings.voor: Party mense dra tradisionele klere elke gewone dag van die week.
veranderings.na: Party mense dra elke gewone dag tradisionele klere.
veranderings.rede: Afrikaans puts the time phrase before the object, and 'van die week' adds nothing to 'elke gewone dag'; saves three words.

veranderings.voor: Indiese gemeenskap van die stad Durban
veranderings.rede: 'van die stad Durban' is wooden; 'in Durban' is the natural phrasing and saves two words.
The idiomatic Afrikaans is 'n kwart brood', which the lesson's own glossary entry already uses.

veranderings.voor: 'n Taal wat die land se wette en regering amptelik erken.
veranderings.na: 'n Taal wat amptelik deur die land se wette en regering erken word.
veranderings.rede: As written 'wat' can be read as the subject, so the language seems to recognise the laws; the passive removes the ambiguity (adds two words).
